signal.key_findings: mean_eval_reward=-114.97, all 20 episodes early-terminated at mean len=68.4. proximity_delta dominates at +55.9/episode (83.2% signed share). landing_bonus is completely dead: 0.0% active rate, 0.0 magnitude share.
signal.component_anomalies: landing_bonus is a phantom component — present in code (w_land=80) but contributes zero signal (active_rate=0.0%). All learning relies on proximity_delta, which encourages approaching origin but not soft landing.
signal.mechanism_hypothesis: The landing_bonus's multi-factor gating (dist_factor=e^(-dist/0.3), velocity/angle factors zero above |v|>0.3 or |angle|>0.3) is too strict: the lander never simultaneously satisfies distance, velocity, and angle conditions at leg contact, so the bonus never fires and cannot guide soft-landing behavior.
signal.decision_implication: PATCH landing_bonus: relax thresholds (e.g., dist_factor sigma from 0.3→1.5, velocity/angle cutoffs from 0.3→1.0) so the component activates and provides a usable landing gradient. Keep other components unchanged.

args.key_findings: 1) All 20/20 eval episodes crash early (mean len=68.4, score=-114.97, range [-140.9, -96.6]), despite generated_reward being positive (mean=0.624/step, ≈+46.6/episode). 2) proximity_delta dominates generated reward (83.2% signed share, episode_sum_mean=+55.9) while the only safety component, velocity_danger, contributes just -12.7% share (-8.54/episode). The agent is rewarded for fast approach to target regardless of crash outcome.
args.component_anomalies: landing_bonus is completely dead: 0.0% activation, episode_sum_mean=0.00. Its multiplicative gate (contact × e^(-dist/0.3) × velocity/angle factors) never fires because the agent never simultaneously satisfies leg contact AND low distance/velocity/angle. This is a sparse-reward trap — the bonus only rewards already-perfect landings it will never see.
args.mechanism_hypothesis: The proximity_delta incentive (+50 weight) overwhelms velocity_danger (-0.15 weight) and orientation_penalty (-5 weight), creating a "dive-bomb" policy: the agent maximizes progress-toward-target and ignores safe approach, yielding positive generated reward while crashing every episode. The landing_bonus cannot correct this because its gate never opens — it's a dead component providing zero learning signal.
args.decision_implication: REBUILD landing_bonus. Replace the strict multiplicative gate (which requires near-perfect landing to activate) with a progressive signal that rewards partial approach quality — e.g., scale bonus by distance alone, or reward contact + low-velocity independent of exact position. Also consider increasing velocity_danger weight or making proximity_delta conditional on safe-speed near target to counter the dive-bomb incentive.
